subject: Reclass Plan: Pipeline Tiers & Office Hours for Rep Training
body:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sales Managers <sales-managers@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Reclass Plan: Pipeline Tiers & Office Hours for Rep Training

Team,

We need to finalize a small set of changes to how reps classify opportunities for the upcoming Q4 forecast cycle. The goal is to reduce ambiguous entries in Commit and Best Case that are inflating the weekly OU. The proposed changes are in the attached spreadsheet ("pipeline-reclass-draft.xlsx") and cover:

- Clear entry criteria for Commit (legal + PO or signatures + agreed delivery window)
- Best Case definition tightened to "contract in legal review OR verbal agreement with documented next steps"
- Pipeline (aka Pipeline - Early) to be used only for lead-to-opps with no commercial engagement yet

I want a short training sequence for managers + reps next week: 30-minute office hours + a 60-minute role-play session. Proposed slots are in the linked calendar. Please review the attachment and reply with blockers or redlines by EOD tomorrow.

Attachments: [Attachment: pipeline-reclass-draft.xlsx (Excel)]

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, RevOps | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

---

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Sales Managers <sales-managers@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reclass Plan: Pipeline Tiers & Office Hours for Rep Training

Marcus —

Quick read-through looks sensible. Two quick questions:
1) For Commit, is an LOI sufficient or do we require purchase order/signature?
2) For Best Case verbal agreements, do we need a quote shared from sales or is an email thread acceptable?

I can run this by my managers in the 10/21 sync, but wanted to flag those edge cases.

Also, please add a one-slide decision tree for reps — that helps reduce "I thought this was Commit" replies.

— Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Regional Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

---

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@apertureanalytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reclass Plan: Pipeline Tiers & Office Hours for Rep Training

Marcus,

Appreciate the heads-up — this change affects our forecast report into Redwood as a partner for Q4. Two quick items from our side:
- We can't surface "verbal agreement" in our aggregate report; can you give us a clear mapping table to HubSpot stages so our RevOps can align their exports?
- Any change to the timing thresholds (e.g., 14-day close expectation for Commit) will require us to rerun our weekly reconciliation scripts.

Happy to join the office hours if that helps.

Best,
Samantha Lee
Head of RevOps | Aperture Analytics
Samantha.Lee@apertureanalytics.com

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reclass Plan: Pipeline Tiers & Office Hours for Rep Training

Folks —

Answering Lauren and Samantha inline:
- LOI: acceptable for Best Case but NOT for Commit. Commit requires signature or PO (we'll add a "Commit checklist" column in the spreadsheet).
- Verbal agreement: must be accompanied by an owner-logged next step in HubSpot (quote sent / meeting scheduled). We'll map HubSpot stage IDs in the spreadsheet and include a 1-slide mapping for partner exports.
- Timing thresholds: keeping timing defaults out of the definitions for now — we'll recommend a "typical close" metric but not hard enforcement. If Aperture needs a fixed threshold for their scripts, we'll provide a CSV export of the mapping.

Next actions I can take: finalize the spreadsheet with the checklist and HubSpot stage IDs, prep the quick decision tree slide. Marcus, if you approve, I'll book the two training slots and assign prep to Marissa.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Manager, FP&A | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sales Managers <sales-managers@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@apertureanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Reclass Plan: Pipeline Tiers & Office Hours for Rep Training

Thanks everyone — good progress. Summary of decisions and next steps: 

1) Definitions locked (for Q4 pilot):
   - Commit = signed contract OR PO OR DocuSign-completed envelope.
   - Best Case = LOI OR documented verbal agreement + logged HubSpot next step.
   - Pipeline = opportunity without commercial engagement (MQL/SQL stages only).

2) Deliverables by EOD 10/23:
   - Karthik: spreadsheet updated with HubSpot stage IDs + Commit checklist. [Attachment included]
   - Marissa: one-slide decision tree + training deck ("training-slides-v2.pptx").
   - Marcus: schedule office hours and roleplay; calendar invite posted here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=officehours-reclass

3) Aperture-specific note: we'll provide a CSV mapping for your reconciliation scripts and a short doc describing the "logged next step" format. Samantha — can your RevOps lead take the CSV and confirm before we go live?

4) Rollout: pilot for strategic deals only in W1 of Nov; full roll starting Nov 15 if pilot metrics show fewer "Category changes" during weekly reviews.

Attachments: [Attachment: pipeline-reclass-draft.xlsx (Excel)] [Attachment: training-slides-v2.pptx (PowerPoint)]

Please mark any remaining redlines in the sheet. If none, I will post the final version and the DocuSign template link to the deal record (HubSpot).

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, RevOps | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

[Forwarded message headers preserved where applicable]
